messages:
Emma: quick sync — I'm finalizing the benchmark narrative for launch. need 3 things: 1) pick the primary chart we show on the landing page, 2) demo path that pairs with that chart, 3) inbound routing rules for high-intent leads. ETA EOD? :hourglass: 
Javier: got it. for chart options i sketched 3 slices last night: latency vs cost scatter, tokens/second bar by model, and cumulative-cost-over-requests curve. my lean is the scatter — it's immediately intuitive. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Priya: scatter is strong for press & docs, but for webinar audience maybe cumulative-cost-over-requests is more persuasive (shows long-run savings). can we use both in different places? landing = scatter, webinar deck = cumulative curve.
Tom: agree with priya. landing needs one punchy visual. scatter + callout annotation about typical real-world slice (e.g., chat support 1-3s, batch-embed 100-200ms) would help.
Emma: nice. Javier — can you produce a clean scatter with two highlighted bands (low-latency tier, cost-optimized tier)? use these labels: `Fast path (SLA)`, `Cost path (low $/token)`.
Javier: will do. quick Q on axes: x = latency p50 (ms), y = $/k tokens ?
Priya: yes x = median latency (ms), y = $ per 1k tokens. add point shapes for model families. legend: Redwood-hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.
Tom: for demo path i propose a 3-step flow we can run live and record 90s clips for the landing page: 1) low-latency chat (small prompt, realtime), 2) throughput batch embeddings (large-batch), 3) graceful fallback to quantized variant when capacity constrained. each step maps to a region on the scatter.
Emma: perfect. can we script the demo so clips are <90s each? marketing prefers short snackable assets.
Javier: yes — i'll mock the scripts and record samples. also export a static PNG + an interactive embed for docs.
Priya: inbound routing — two asks: a) which leads get webinar nurture vs sales outreach, b) what metadata we capture from the trial/landing form to route properly.
Emma: routing proposal: leads that view the scatter + click "see pricing" -> high intent -> route to SDR queue A (enterprise). webinar signups and low-touch trials -> nurture flow (email sequence + on-demand webinar). capture `company_size`, `deployment_preference` (hosted/dedicated/private), `latency_priority` (high/medium/low).
Tom: add `expected_monthly_tokens` too — helps quota/qualify.
Priya: agree. for nurture content we should tailor based on `latency_priority`: high -> technical whitepaper + latency benchmarks, low -> case studies and pricing.
ops-bot: Reminder: make sure GTM-tracking keys are set in landing template. Existing landing has `utm_source=benchmark_launch` and `data-layer` schema.
Emma: thanks ops-bot. ownership: Javier = visuals & demo clips (due tomorrow EOD), Priya = nurture email copy + routing config (due tomorrow noon), Tom = demo scripts + recording plan (due tomorrow EOD). I'll assemble landing copy and CTA variations.
Javier: uploading first pass shortly.
Priya: routing docs: i'll post the draft config to #sales-integrations after lunch for review.
Tom: i'll mock the 3x 90s clips in a small recording session at 3pm, ping if you want to watch.
Emma: yay. microcopy check: two CTA options — `Get benchmarked` vs `See your latency & cost`. which one converts better?
Priya: `See your latency & cost` is clearer on value. `Get benchmarked` is vaguer.
Javier: agree. final note: add a tiny callout on the scatter: "Real-world slices — results vary by prompt and sequence length" to avoid overclaiming.
Emma: good legal-safe line. thanks everyone. will close the loop when assets are uploaded. :rocket:
